title: Renewable furfural and 2-methylfuran valorization: catalytic routes for the production of sustainable aviation C-15 fuel precursors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4775-4792
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00639B, Review Article
